authorityBasis: Independent review of this isolated bundle input and its UID-free ACTIVE vocabulary and L3 boundary authority only.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Translate one root inside (−1,1) and the other outside into the two possible root orders; use the quadratic sign at −1 and 1 to obtain each parameter interval, then apply any integer filter.
clusters.variationPolicy: Which side contains the exterior root and the numeric coefficients vary; the exhaustive endpoint-sign branch check remains fixed.
clusters.noSeparateRule: One reusable root-location/sign skeleton handles both exterior-root branches.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Impose D≥0 for the first quadratic; for the second expression required positive on all real x, split by its leading coefficient (negative, zero, positive), test the constant or vertex minimum as appropriate, then intersect the parameter constraints and apply any integer filter.
clusters.variationPolicy: Coefficients and resulting integer set vary; the zero-leading-coefficient case and intersection of two different requirements are structural.
clusters.noSeparateRule: This conjunction of root-existence and all-real positivity conditions is a distinct reusable skeleton.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Compute the discriminant or reduced discriminant, impose its strict or weak sign for the required root type, solve the resulting parameter inequality, then extract the requested bound, range, or least integer.
clusters.variationPolicy: The coefficients, strict/weak sign, and final requested form vary; the same one-parameter discriminant inequality drives all items in this cluster.
clusters.noSeparateRule: Do not split by coefficient values, sign direction, minimum-versus-range wording, or integer display when the discriminant inequality is the decisive skeleton.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Translate equal-magnitude opposite-sign roots into zero root sum and negative product via Vieta; substitute into coefficient expressions, apply natural-number and product-bound restrictions, enumerate admissible parameters, and aggregate the requested coefficient expression.
clusters.l3BoundaryFit: Fits the boundary's root-position/sign-condition branch even though Vieta, not D, is decisive.
clusters.variationPolicy: Root-sign structure, coefficient constants, and product threshold vary; Vieta plus parameter filtering is fixed.
clusters.noSeparateRule: Treat Vieta as part of this root-condition skeleton; do not add a redundant roots-coefficients cross tag when it is the primary route.
Applying the discriminant independently to each listed quadratic and selecting those with D>0 is the direct L3 discriminant test; it does not require a separate L4.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: For each quadratic, solve D_i<0 to get its nonreal-root parameter range; interpret 'at least one' as the union of ranges and retain any explicit nonzero/nondegeneracy condition.
clusters.variationPolicy: The two discriminant formulas and interval endpoints vary; the union rule for an at-least-one condition remains fixed.
clusters.noSeparateRule: The disjunctive combination of several nonreal-root ranges is a distinct reusable skeleton.
